tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List everything the demo store sells, with product ids and prices. Prices are in USD.

tools.name: create_checkout
tools.description: Start a checkout (an Agentic Commerce Protocol checkout session) with the products and quantities the user wants. Returns the session id, the cart and its total. If no api_key is given, a sandbox key is created and returned.

tools.name: update_checkout
tools.description: Replace the items in an open checkout (e.g. the user changed their mind). Any PayPal payment created for the old total is dropped.

tools.name: get_checkout
tools.description: Read the current cart, total, payment status and order of a checkout.

tools.name: request_paypal_payment
tools.description: Create a PayPal (sandbox) payment for the checkout's exact total. Returns approve_url, the PayPal link where the user approves the payment.

tools.name: wait_for_payment_approval
tools.description: Wait (up to 45s per call) until PayPal reports the user approved the payment. Returns still_waiting if the user has not approved yet.

tools.name: complete_checkout
tools.description: Place the order. With payment "paypal" the approved PayPal payment is captured first, and the order only goes through if PayPal confirms the money for the exact total. "mock" skips real payment (testing only).

tools.name: cancel_checkout
tools.description: Cancel an open checkout. Nothing is charged.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_checkout" references sensitive artifacts (api_key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Start a checkout (an Agentic Commerce Protocol checkout session) with the products and quantities the user wants. Returns the session id, the cart and its total…

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "create_checkout" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Start a checkout (an Agentic Commerce Protocol checkout session) with the products and quantities the user wants. Returns the session id, the cart and its total. If you have no api_key yet, leave it out: a sandbox key is created and returned — reuse it in every later call." → after: "Start a checkout (an Agentic Commerce Protocol checkout session) with the products and quantities the user wants. Returns the session id, the cart and its total. If no api_key is given, a sandbox key is created and returned."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
